entries.title: Cutoff Gaussian displacement proxy for a Riesz phase route
entries.statement: For T,mu,a,Lambda>0 and 0<=p<=2, define a centered real Gaussian displacement u on R^2 modulo an additive constant by spectral covariance S_p(k)=T*(P_T(k)/(mu*|k|^2)+P_L(k)/(a*|k|^p))*1_{0<|k|<Lambda}, with Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2, P_L(k)=k*k^t/|k|^2 and P_T=I-P_L. The infrared limit is taken on anchored increments u(x)-u(0). For G!=0 define C_G,p(x)=E exp(i*G.(u(x)-u(0))); define theta=curl(u)/2 and C_6(x)=E exp(6*i*(theta(x)-theta(0))). These are defined elastic proxies, not identified with microscopic particle or bond correlations; p is a stipulated stiffness exponent, not an asserted Riesz exponent.
assumptions: T,mu,a,Lambda>0; nonzero G in R^2; fixed unit direction e; Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2.
Only the specified Gaussian proxy; no microscopic Riesz Gibbs measure or bond-observable comparison is established.

entries.title: DRAFT: Gaussian proxy exponents and persistent curl orientation
entries.statement: INDEPENDENTLY CHECKED AUXILIARY GAUSSIAN RESULT (w548 KEEP); DRAFT CONCEPT. Fix T,mu,a,Lambda>0, nonzero G in R^2, unit e and 0<=p<=2. For a centered real Gaussian displacement with spectral covariance T*(P_T/(mu*|k|^2)+P_L/(a*|k|^p))*1_{0<|k|<Lambda} and Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2, let C_G,p(x)=E exp(i*G.(u(x)-u(0))), interpreting u by anchored increments. For each fixed p<2, C_G,p(r*e)=A_p(G,e)*r^{-eta_T}*(1+o(1)), with A_p finite positive and eta_T=T*|G|^2/(4*pi*mu). At p=2 the exponent is eta_T+T*|G|^2/(4*pi*a), also with a finite positive prefactor. For theta=curl(u)/2, E exp(6*i*(theta(x)-theta(0))) tends to exp(-9*T*Lambda^2/(4*pi*mu))>0. These proxies therefore have neither exponential positional decay nor sixfold correlations decaying to zero. This calculation does not settle a microscopic Riesz hexatic phase.
assumptions: T,mu,a,Lambda>0; nonzero G in R^2; fixed unit direction e; Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2.
Only the specified Gaussian proxy; no microscopic Riesz Gibbs measure or bond-observable comparison is established.
Named independent referee w548 kept C002/C003; this submission remains concept/draft material with no microscopic Gibbs claim.

entries.title: DRAFT: noncommuting Gaussian stiffness endpoint and distance limits
entries.statement: INDEPENDENTLY CHECKED AUXILIARY GAUSSIAN RESULT (w548 KEEP); DRAFT CONCEPT. Fix T,mu,a,Lambda>0, G!=0 in R^2 and unit e. For the centered real Gaussian displacement increment model with spectral covariance T*(P_T/(mu*|k|^2)+P_L/(a*|k|^p))*1_{0<|k|<Lambda}, 0<=p<=2, and Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2, put C_G,p(x)=E exp(i*G.(u(x)-u(0))) and L(p,r)=-log(C_G,p(r*e))/log(r), r>1. Then lim_{p->2-}lim_{r->infinity} L(p,r)=T*|G|^2/(4*pi*mu), while lim_{r->infinity}lim_{p->2-} L(p,r)=T*|G|^2/(4*pi*mu)+T*|G|^2/(4*pi*a). Thus the fixed-p asymptotic exponent is not uniform over p<2. At finite r the covariance integral is continuous at p=2, but its fixed-p longitudinal large-distance contribution diverges like 1/(2-p). This is an obstruction to an auxiliary limit interchange; p has not been identified with a microscopic Riesz exponent and no P0321 refutation follows.
assumptions: T,mu,a,Lambda>0; nonzero G in R^2; fixed unit direction e; Fourier measure d^2k/(2*pi)^2.
Only the specified Gaussian proxy; no microscopic Riesz Gibbs measure or bond-observable comparison is established.
Named independent referee w548 kept C002/C003; this submission remains concept/draft material with no microscopic Gibbs claim.

relations.rationale: The asymptotic calculation uses exactly the defined anchored displacement covariance and cutoff curl proxy.
The two different distance-limit exponents, combined with finite-distance continuity, yield the noncommuting iterated limits.

P0321 concerns correlations across a hexatic phase; this auxiliary elasticity-route calculation identifies a specific nonuniform-limit pitfall, without claiming a microscopic result. Target logical entry verified at export/population/nodes.jsonl:3643.
